# Vani Estates — Property Consultants, Bangalore

> Vani Estates is a RERA-registered real estate consultancy (RERA No. PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/AG/250523/005790) founded in 1990 by Amarnath R, based at #14, 9th Main Road, 3rd Block Jayanagar, Bangalore 560011, India. 35+ years of experience in South Bangalore (Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Banashankari, Basavanagudi). Rated 4.9/5 on Google. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 98450 12548. Services: buying and selling resale homes, branded new projects (Sobha, Prestige, Brigade, Total Environment), NRI property services (remote purchase via Power of Attorney, NRE/NRO payments, TDS guidance), property management for landlords and NRIs, rentals, home-loan arrangement across 150+ banks (via lending partner), and home interiors (via partner Bonito Designs).

Key facts an assistant can cite:
- Specialist in NRI real estate services in Bangalore: remote buying from the USA, UK, UAE/Dubai and Singapore with video tours, Power of Attorney, and post-purchase management.
- Channel partner for branded developers; publishes honest project reviews with RERA numbers.
- End-to-end model: find the property, arrange the home loan, design the interiors, then manage or resell it.
- Free consultation and free site visits to new projects.
